pr_title: fix: ignore proxy for local address supports comma separated values
pr_body:
# Make Blazor Debugger noproxy more flexible to allow for more complex scenarios.

<!-- Once all that is done, you're ready to go. Open the PR with the content below. -->

Summary of the changes (Less than 80 chars): Allows comma based NO_PROXY values by WebAssembly Debugger

## Description

Splits the NO_PROXY value to support support comma separated lists of NO_PROXY. Continues to work with previously accepted NO_PROXY values.

Fixes #52475

issue_context.title: Blazor Debugger does not support comma separated NO_PROXY value
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

Similar to #22012 - I'm unable to debug Blazor applications. 

Changing `NO_PROXY` to `localhost` fixes the issue as a temporary workaround however I already had `NO_PROXY` values set that I needed for other applications (such as Git).

My `NO_PROXY` was previously set to: `.example.com, .sub.example.com`. 

Adding localhost as one of these values: `localhost,.example.com,.sub.example.com` does not seem to get picked up by Visual Studio as I still get the error:

```
Invalid value for NO_PROXY: localhost,.example.com,.sub.example.com (Expected values: "localhost" or "127.0.0.1")
```

### Expected Behavior

Expected Visual Studio to see that `localhost` was already one of the `NO_PROXY` values rather than requiring an exclusive value of `localhost` on its own. 

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Exceptions (if any)

_No response_

### .NET Version

8.0.100

### Anything else?

Both Visual Studio 17.8.2 & 17.9.0 Preview 1.1

# Help Wanted

Make noproxy more flexible to allow for more complex scenarios.

## Issue Summary

We currently do a check for localhost or 127.0.0.1 [here](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Components/WebAssembly/Server/src/DebugProxyLauncher.cs#L41-L53). It seems that the format for NO_PROXY is more general than this, and allow multiple values to be specified.

## Potential Design

Update the check to try and parse the comma separated list of values and make the same check that happens today over each value available.

## Code References

https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Components/WebAssembly/Server/src/DebugProxyLauncher.cs#L41-L53

review_comments:
Would it be worth using `StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries` so it's also allowed to have spaces in the string?

I notice your original example was `.example.com, .sub.example.com` but without trimming it wouldn't work to specify `.example.com, .sub.example.com, localhost`.
